name: Service Line Locality
description: Name of the city, town, village, or hamlet where the service line is located.

name: Street Address
description: Street number and name where the service line is located.

name: Zip Code
description: The five-digit code where the service line is located.

name: State
description: State

name: Lead Gooseneck, Pigtail or Connector Currently Present
description: The presence of a short section of piping that can be bent and used for connections between the water main and the service line.

name: Current Public Side SL Material
description: For public side service line (SL) material that is not currently lead (e.g., copper or plastic), indicates if it was ever lead in the past.

name: Was Public SL Material Ever Previously Lead
description: The method water system used to identify the public side service line (SL) material.

name: Public SL Material Verification Method
description: The month, day, and/or year the public side service line (SL) was installed or replaced with the current line.

name: Public SL Installation or Replacement Date
description: The diameter of the public side service line (SL) in inches.

name: Public SL Size
description: The diameter of the public side service line (SL) in inches.

name: Customer SL Material
description: The material of the service line (SL) owned by a customer.

name: Customer SL Material Verification Method
description: The method water system used to identify the material of the customer-owned portion of the service line (SL), typically piping from a curb stop to the building/house.

name: Lead Solder Present
description: Whether or not lead solder is present on copper piping.

name: Building Type
description: The classification of the house/building connected to the water main through the service line.

name: POU or POE Treatment Present
description: Whether or not there is a water treatment system inside the house/building.

name: Customer SL Installation or Replacement Date
description: The month, day, and/or year the customer side service line (SL) was installed or replaced.

name: Customer SL Size
description: The diameter of the customer side service line (SL) in inches.

name: SL Category
description: Type of service line according to drinking water regulations.

name: Note
description: A dedicated section in the inventory to list any information that cannot be listed in any of the inventory fields.

name: Location
description: Georeference field.

name: Counties
description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Counties' (9yqb-tdyd) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

name: ComputedFieldforMapping1
description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'ComputedFieldforMapping1' (assa-msit) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'School Districts 2016.shp' (5edz-4hdv) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
